strategy.overview: Complete the green W-A-R drop bank to light locks, then shoot The Wall from the upper-right flipper. After two locks, the next Wall shot starts three-ball Multiball. The Wall is also the repeatable Jackpot shot; use the Pit magnet when it is lit to slow the feed and set up the upper-flipper shot.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete W-A-R to light locks, then shoot The Wall from the upper-right flipper. Lock two balls there and shoot The Wall again for three-ball Multiball. During Multiball, keep returning to The Wall for repeatable Jackpots; when the Pit magnet is lit, use it to help line up the shot.
strategy.summary: Complete W-A-R, collect two locks at The Wall, then shoot The Wall again for three-ball Multiball. Return to The Wall for repeatable Jackpots. Use the lit Pit magnet to control its feed when available.

quickInfo.name: Light Locks
quickInfo.summary: Complete the green W-A-R drop bank; each target can light its corresponding lock.

quickInfo.name: Collect Locks
quickInfo.summary: Shoot The Wall from the upper-right flipper.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: After two locks, shoot The Wall once more.

quickInfo.name: Score Jackpots
quickInfo.summary: Keep shooting The Wall during Multiball.

steps.text: Complete the green W-A-R drop targets to light the locks.
Feed the upper-right flipper and shoot The Wall to collect each lit lock.
After two balls are locked, shoot The Wall again to start three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, return to The Wall for each repeatable Jackpot.

alternatives.title: Use the Pit magnet
alternatives.when: Use this when the Magnet insert is lit and the Wall feed is difficult.

steps.text: Shoot the Pit ramp to collect the lit magnet feature.
Wait through the 'Don't flip' hold, then flip when prompted to send the ball toward The Wall.
Roll through an inlane to light the opposite Jetway shot.
Shoot the lit spinner lane to collect that team and advance the Jetways.
Collect all six teams to light Extra Ball at the center lane.

machineSetup: Confirm whether locks are shared between players; on a shared-lock setup, another player can take the balls you qualified.
Test the W-A-R drops, upper-right flipper, The Wall, Pit ramp and magnet, spinner, inlanes, and physical locks before competitive play.

cautions.issue: Sudden Death can begin without a controlled qualification.
cautions.response: When it starts, shoot the Pit ramp for one-million awards and magnet extensions instead of waiting for a planned setup.
